passages.text: “If one’s offering is a peace offering and he offers an animal from the herd, whether male or female, he must present it without blemish before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
A person may bring a peace offering to God.
He may choose an animal from the herd.
The animal may be a male.
The animal may be a female.
The animal must have no blemish.
He must present the animal before the LORD.
passages.original: וְאִם־ זֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים קָרְבָּנ֑וֹ אִ֤ם מִן־ הַבָּקָר֙ ה֣וּא מַקְרִ֔יב אִם־ זָכָר֙ אִם־ נְקֵבָ֔ה תָּמִ֥ים יַקְרִיבֶ֖נּוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: He is to lay his hand on the head of the offering and slaughter it at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron’s sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood on all sides of the altar.
passages.sermon:
The worshiper brings an animal for a peace offering to the LORD.
The animal must be without blemish.
The worshiper lays his hand on the head of his offering.
He slaughters the animal at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
Aaron’s sons are priests.
The priests take the blood of the animal.
The priests sprinkle the blood on all sides of the altar.
passages.original: וְסָמַ֤ךְ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ קָרְבָּנ֔וֹ וּשְׁחָט֕וֹ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְזָרְק֡וּ בְּנֵי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים אֶת־ הַדָּ֛ם עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: From the peace offering he is to bring an offering made by fire to the LORD: the fat that covers the entrails, all the fat that is on them, both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he is to remove with the kidneys.
passages.sermon:
The person brings a peace offering to the LORD.
He brings an offering made by fire.
He brings the fat that covers the entrails.
He brings all the fat that is on the entrails.
He brings both kidneys.
He brings the fat that is on the kidneys near the loins.
He brings the lobe of the liver.
He removes the lobe of the liver with the kidneys.
passages.original: וְהִקְרִיב֙ מִזֶּ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֔ים אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה אֶת־ הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־ הַקֶּ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ הַחֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַקֶּֽרֶב׃ וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־ הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־ הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־ הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־ הַכְּלָי֖וֹת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃

passages.text: Then Aaron’s sons are to burn it on the altar atop the burnt offering that is on the burning wood, as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Aaron’s sons are priests.
They must burn the offering on the altar.
They place it on top of the burnt offering.
The burnt offering is on the wood.
The wood is on the fire.
This is an offering made by fire.
This offering gives a pleasing smell to the LORD.
passages.original: וְהִקְטִ֨ירוּ אֹת֤וֹ בְנֵֽי־ אַהֲרֹן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עַל־ הָ֣עֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ הָעֵצִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הָאֵ֑שׁ אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: If, however, one’s peace offering to the LORD is from the flock, he must present a male or female without blemish.
passages.sermon:
A person brings a peace offering to the LORD.
He chooses an animal from the flock.
The animal can be a male.
The animal can be a female.
The animal must have no blemish.
He must present this animal.
passages.original: וְאִם־ מִן־ הַצֹּ֧אן קָרְבָּנ֛וֹ לְזֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַיהוָ֑ה זָכָר֙ א֣וֹ נְקֵבָ֔ה תָּמִ֖ים יַקְרִיבֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: If he is presenting a lamb for his offering, he must present it before the LORD.
passages.sermon: A man brings an offering to the LORD.\r\nHe chooses a lamb for his offering.\r\nHe must bring the lamb before the LORD.
passages.original: אִם־ כֶּ֥שֶׂב הֽוּא־ מַקְרִ֖יב אֶת־ קָרְבָּנ֑וֹ וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹת֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: He is to lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood on all sides of the altar.
passages.sermon:
The worshiper brings an animal for a peace offering to the LORD.
The worshiper lays his hand on the head of his animal.
He does this to show the animal is his offering.
He slaughters the animal in front of the Tent of Meeting.
Aaron’s sons are priests.
The priests take the animal’s blood.
The priests sprinkle the blood on all sides of the altar.
passages.original: וְסָמַ֤ךְ אֶת־ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ קָרְבָּנ֔וֹ וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ֠זָרְקוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־ דָּמ֛וֹ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: And from the peace offering he shall bring an offering made by fire to the LORD consisting of its fat: the entire fat tail cut off close to the backbone, the fat that covers the entrails, all the fat that is on them, both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he is to remove with the kidneys.
passages.sermon:
The man brings a peace offering to the LORD.
He brings an offering made by fire.
He brings the fat from the animal.
He brings the entire fat tail.
He cuts the fat tail off close to the backbone.
He brings the fat that covers the entrails.
He brings all the fat that is on the entrails.
He brings both kidneys.
He brings the fat that is on the kidneys.
He brings the fat that is near the loins.
He brings the lobe of the liver.
He removes the lobe of the liver with the kidneys.
passages.original: וְהִקְרִ֨יב מִזֶּ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֮ אִשֶּׁ֣ה לַיהוָה֒ חֶלְבּוֹ֙ הָאַלְיָ֣ה תְמִימָ֔ה לְעֻמַּ֥ת הֶעָצֶ֖ה יְסִירֶ֑נָּה וְאֶת־ הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־ הַקֶּ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ הַחֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַקֶּֽרֶב׃ וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־ הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־ הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־ הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־ הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃

passages.text: Then the priest is to burn them on the altar as food, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The priest takes the fat parts from the offering.
The priest places them on the altar.
The priest burns them with fire.
The burning is an offering to the LORD.
The offering is like food for the LORD.
passages.original: וְהִקְטִיר֥וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה לֶ֥חֶם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: If one’s offering is a goat, he is to present it before the LORD.
passages.sermon: A person may bring an offering to God.\r\nThe offering may be a goat.\r\nHe must present the goat before the LORD.
passages.original: וְאִ֥ם עֵ֖ז קָרְבָּנ֑וֹ וְהִקְרִיב֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: He must lay his hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood on all sides of the altar.
passages.sermon:
A man brings a goat as his offering to the LORD.
He stands in front of the Tent of Meeting.
He lays his hand on the goat’s head.
He kills the goat there.
Aaron’s sons are priests.
The priests take the goat’s blood.
They sprinkle the blood on every side of the altar.
passages.original: וְסָמַ֤ךְ אֶת־ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ֠זָרְקוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־ דָּמ֛וֹ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: And from his offering he shall present an offering made by fire to the LORD: the fat that covers the entrails, all the fat that is on them, both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the lobe of the liver, which he is to remove with the kidneys.
passages.sermon:
The person brings an offering to the LORD.
He presents part of the animal as an offering by fire.
He gives the fat that covers the inner parts.
He gives all the fat that is on the inner parts.
He gives both kidneys.
He gives the fat that is on the kidneys, near the loins.
He gives the lobe of the liver.
He removes the lobe of the liver with the kidneys.
passages.original: וְהִקְרִ֤יב מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ קָרְבָּנ֔וֹ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָ֑ה אֶת־ הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־ הַקֶּ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ הַחֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַקֶּֽרֶב׃ וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־ הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־ הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־ הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־ הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃

passages.text: Then the priest is to burn the food on the altar as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma. All the fat is the LORD’s.
passages.sermon:
The priest must burn the food on the altar.
He offers it as a fire offering to the LORD.
The offering gives a pleasing smell.
All the fat belongs to the LORD.
passages.original: וְהִקְטִירָ֥ם הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה לֶ֤חֶם אִשֶּׁה֙ לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ כָּל־ חֵ֖לֶב לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: This is a permanent statute for the generations to come, wherever you live: You must not eat any fat or any blood.”
passages.sermon:
God gave a law to the Israelites.
This law will last forever.
This law is for all your descendants.
This law applies wherever you live.
You must not eat any fat.
You must not eat any blood.
passages.original: חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בְּכֹ֖ל מֽוֹשְׁבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם כָּל־ חֵ֥לֶב וְכָל־ דָּ֖ם לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃פ
